items.text: True actionable findings survive the second pass (recall preserved).
Plausible false positives and unreachable concerns are dropped by the second pass (precision gained).
Diagnostics already enforced by tooling do not survive as findings.
Retention behavior is repeatable across repetitions: the same findings survive or drop run to run.
True findings whose exact fix is unknown are surfaced as findings with an honest fix direction or as open questions — not forced into speculative patches.
Evidence for whether numeric 0-10 scoring improves precision without reducing recall is recorded, to justify keeping or replacing it with a simpler evidence/actionability gate.
